intro: First John is a letter about knowing God, and knowing that we belong to him.
Across five chapters, John returns again and again to three marks of real faith: believing in Jesus, obeying God, and loving one another.
Tradition holds that the apostle John wrote it, late in his life.
Listen for its simplest line: God is love.

card.key: Walk in the light (1) · What manner of love (3) · God is love (4)
